summary.headline: Acknowledgments and Colophon
summary.text: Acknowledgments to Hermann Usener and Joseph Bidez, with thanks to the prefects of the Marciana Library for transmitting codices to Bologna, Breslau, Munich, and Ghent. Dated Brussels, 1 March 1900, and signed F. C.
